transcode_video_clip: transcode a video clip from input path to output path with seek time and duration
get_video_metadata: get video metadata including duration, fps, width, height, and frame count from a video file
normalize_video_ffmpeg: normalize a video to target dimensions and fps using ffmpeg with configurable codec and CRF
create_VideoMetadata_dataclass: create a VideoMetadata dataclass to hold video properties like duration, fps, width, and height
review_transcode_env_config: review the transcode function environment variable configuration for codec, CRF, fps, and resolution settings
